defensiveAbilities.name: Crushing Gravity
defensiveAbilities.description: 5 feet. A vorthuul is surrounded by the crushing gravitational forces of a black hole. A creature that enters or begins its turn in the aura takes 3d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage (Basic DC 26 Fortitude Saving Throw save).

defensiveAbilities.name: Event Horizon
defensiveAbilities.description: A vorthuul naturally draws in light. The DC of the flat check to target a vorthuul Concealed or hidden due to dim light or darkness is reduced by 2. A vorthuul takes a –2 circumstance penalty to AC and saving throws against light effects and to AC against attacks from weapons in the laser group.

defensiveAbilities.name: Quantum Duality
defensiveAbilities.description:
Vorthuuls exist in two states: one in perfect tranquility, the other in perpetual agony. The vorthuul gains bonuses depending on the dominant state. They decide which is dominant as a free action when they roll initiative.

  • Absolute Tranquility The vorthuul gains a +1 status bonus to saves against emotion effects and resistance 10 to mental damage.

  • Everburning Agony The vorthuul gains a +1 status bonus to saves against vitality effects and resistance 10 to fire damage.

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Gravity Maelstrom
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per hour

Effect The vorthuul intensifies their gravitational pull for 1 minute, increasing the radius of their crushing gravity aura to 20 feet. Additionally, while this aura is expanded, creatures moving in any direction other than directly toward the vorthuul treat squares in the aura as difficult terrain.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quantum Agony
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per round

Requirements The vorthuul is in absolute tranquility state

Effect The vorthuul enters everburning agony in torrents of anguish. Each creature in the vorthuul's crushing gravity aura must succeed at a DC 28 Will Saving Throw save or be Sickened 1 (or Sickened 2 on a critical failure).

offensiveAbilities.name: Quantum Tranquility
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per round

Requirements The vorthuul is in everburning agony state

Effect The vorthuul enters absolute tranquility in a wave of oppressive stillness. Each creature in the vorthuul's crushing gravity aura must succeed at a DC 28 Fortitude Saving Throw save or be Slowed 1 for 1 round (or slowed 1 for 3 rounds on a critical failure).

offensiveAbilities.name: Singularity Pocket
offensiveAbilities.description: The vorthuul forces their physical and psychological torment upon a creature they touch. The target must succeed at a DC 28 Will Saving Throw save or become Immobilized for 1 minute (Escape dc=28). As long as it's immobilized in this way, it takes 1d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage and 1d6 Mental Damage damage at the end of each of its turns. Creatures that Escape become temporarily immune to this vorthuul's Singularity Pocket for 24 hours.
